C-EXPORT-SINGLE-PAGE.IntentSummary: Export settings dialog on one page: el-tabs removed in favour of one scrollable column with semantic sections (Page / Style / Content / Header & Footer; Info sentence demoted to a subtitle line), theme regrouped into Style, numbering/front-matter/TOC regrouped into Content, header/footer type selects replaced by slot strips with payload-identical derivation, margin presets in front of the four margin inputs, dialog hydration from the remembered appearance options (mark-last-print-options), Reset button, ten locales, new dialog unit suite, graph M-072 + verification V-M-072. The bus 'export' payload, the print (⌘P) and Word export flows, and the e2e selector contracts are unchanged.

Corner.Situation: PDF flavor reopened after an export that used a custom theme, wide margins and a TOC
Corner.Expected: dialog shows exactly those remembered values (theme select, margin preset or Custom with values, TOC on with title); geometry (A4/portrait) stays per-open default

Corner.Situation: Header/footer strip combinations: center-only text; left+right text; all three; all empty; text typed then cleared again
Corner.Expected: payload: center-only → header/footer object type 1; any side slot non-empty → type 2; all empty (or cleared back to empty) → key omitted; strings passed through verbatim

Corner.Situation: Margins: current values match no preset; user picks Wide then switches back to Custom
Corner.Expected: select shows Custom when values match nothing; picking a preset applies its four values; returning to Custom reveals the four inputs without losing the values that were there before the preset detour
page-title field at top plus Style and Content sections only; no Page-geometry and no Header & Footer section; payload carries htmlTitle as today

print-export.spec.ts and export-office.spec.ts pass unchanged: .el-dialog with h3 'Export to PDF', .button-controlls .button-primary click → save dialog → mt_export_pdf, never mt_print_webview; Word export opens no dialog

Corner.Situation: Reset pressed, then Export; Reset pressed, then Cancel
Corner.Expected: Reset restores factory defaults in the form (A4 portrait, 20/15/20/15, no font override, default theme, empty strips, TOC on with empty title); remembered storage changes only on Export — a Reset+Cancel leaves localStorage untouched

Corner.Situation: Locales: ten files after the key churn
Corner.Expected: locale-keys parity green: every new key (section headers, presets, Custom, Reset, slot placeholders) present in all ten locales; dead tab-label keys removed everywhere; no orphans

Corner.Situation: Pre-change localStorage payload (nested header/footer objects, font keys only when overwrite was on, stored by the tabbed dialog)
Corner.Expected: hydration reads it without errors; font-override and customize toggles inferred from key presence; missing keys fall back to defaults

T-001.Title: Foundation: remembered-options accessor in store/editor.js + pure helpers in exportOptions.js (margin presets, header/footer slot derivation) with unit tests

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: store/editor.js exports a read-only getRememberedExportAppearance() returning {...DEFAULT_PRINT_OPTIONS(), ..._lastPrintOptions} (no action behavior change); exportOptions.js gains MARGIN_PRESETS (narrow/normal/wide with the four mm values, labels via t()), matchMarginPreset(values) → narrow|normal|wide|custom, deriveHeaderFooterType({left,center,right}) → 0|1|2; unit tests cover preset matching both directions, derivation corners (empty, center-only, any-side) and the accessor merge with a stale/missing storage fixture.

Evidence.Note: Delivered: store/editor.js getRememberedExportAppearance (defaults merge, map entry added), exportOptions MARGIN_PRESETS/matchMarginPreset/deriveHeaderFooterType; helper pins merged into the existing tests/renderer/components/exportOptions.test.js (nested duplicate file removed same day). Command green: 121 tests across options+editor suites.

T-002.Title: Dialog rewrite, part 1: single-page layout — sections (Page pdf-only / Style incl. theme / Content / Header & Footer pdf-only), subtitle Info line, styledHtml flavor, hydration on open, Reset button; component unit tests

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: index.vue renders no el-tabs/el-tab-pane node; one scrollable column with the four section headers in spec order; Info sentence is a secondary line under the h3; styledHtml shows the page-title field at top and hides both PDF-only sections; on open every appearance field hydrates from getRememberedExportAppearance() with toggle inference (font keys present → overwrite on; headerFooterFontSize present → customize on) and the theme null ↔ 'default' sentinel mapped both ways; Reset restores factory defaults in-form without touching localStorage; corners 1, 4, 6, 8; payload builder unchanged apart from consuming the new state.

Evidence.Note: Delivered in index.vue v2.0.0 with file-local MODULE_CONTRACT: no el-tabs node, sections Page/Style/Content/Header&Footer in order, subtitle Info line, styledHtml flavor (page-title field, no PDF sections), hydration with toggle inference + theme null mapping, Reset in-form (storage untouched). 24 new-behaviour tests in exportSettings-fn.test.js v2.0.0.

T-003.Title: Dialog rewrite, part 2: margin preset select in front of the four inputs (Custom reveals them, values preserved) and headerFooterStrip.vue slot strips replacing the two type selects + six conditional text boxes; payload via deriveHeaderFooterType

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: margin select shows the matching preset or Custom; preset choice applies its values; Custom re-reveals the previous explicit values; strips (new headerFooterStrip.vue, left/center/right slots as real focusable text inputs with tab order left→center→right, empty = absent) replace the selects and conditional boxes; emitted payload identical to the tabbed dialog for none/single/three-cells cases (type derived, same strings); customizeStyle block (styled + font size) stays under the strips; corners 2, 3; the four dead headerFooter text refs collapse into strip state; a remembered three-cells header with empty side strings normalizes to single-cell on re-export (visually equivalent, recorded as conscious normalization).

Evidence.Note: Delivered: marginPresetChoice/customMarginsStash select (Custom restores pre-detour values — corner-3 pinned), headerFooterStrip.vue (3 focusable slots, tab order L→C→R) with deriveHeaderFooterType payload (centre-only→1, any side→2, empty→omitted, three-cells-empty-sides normalizes to 1 — pinned).

T-004.Title: Locales: ten files — new keys (section headers, margin presets incl. Custom, Reset, slot placeholders) added, dead tab-label keys removed; line surgery per file

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: all ten locale files carry identical key sets for exportSettings (new keys translated, tab-label keys removed); corner 7; no wholesale file rewrites, no orphan keys.

Evidence.Note: All ten locales edited via byte-identical roundtrip guard (no reformat): +content.label, +pageMarginPreset, +options.marginPresets.*, +reset, +headerText/footerText/leftSlot/centerSlot/rightSlot; dead keys removed (info/theme/toc labels+descriptions, headerFooter type selects + 6 field labels, pageMargin). locale-keys parity 4/4 green, key count 55.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: both e2e specs pass byte-unchanged (no selector or expectation edits); corner 5; npx vitest run whole-suite green.

Evidence.Note: Dialog suites: exportSettings-fn 24 + exportSettings-deep 20 (rewritten: tab tests removed, strip-text assertions) + exportOptions 17 + editor accessor — all green. e2e chromium: print-export + export-office 6/6 BYTE-UNCHANGED (plan command corrected: no plain webkit lane exists for these specs; repo canon is chromium e2e). Evidence.Note: M-072 ExportSettingsDialog + V-M-072 registered (features.xml entries, index anchors); index.vue carries MODULE_CONTRACT/MAP/CHANGE_SUMMARY from T-002; store/editor.js map updated for the new export. Target lint clean for the bundle; final gate green except the foreign vitest failure above.

Correctness.Note: F1: hydration must map the stored theme null to the select's 'default' sentinel and back — otherwise the theme select shows a stale label after reopen. Disposition: explicit criterion in T-002. F2: a remembered three-cells header/footer with empty side strings (legal output of the tabbed dialog) re-derives as single-cell — payload differs from the last export in the type integer while rendering equivalently. Disposition: recorded as conscious normalization in T-003's criterion. F3: updateTranslations must refresh the margin-preset labels on language change like the other option lists. Disposition: covered by T-001 helper shape (labels via t(), refreshed alongside pageSizeList in updateTranslations).

Security.Note: No new IPC, fs, or network surface: one localStorage read of the app's own key, pure helpers, and in-dialog text inputs whose output flows through the existing print-container rendering unchanged.

UX.Note: F4: slot strips must be real focusable text inputs with a sane tab order, not click-only widgets — otherwise keyboard-only users lose the header/footer path the old text boxes gave them. Disposition: criterion in T-003.

Performance.Note: Dialog mounts once; hydration is a single storage read; type derivation recomputes per keystroke at trivial cost; no render-pipeline or list-loading changes.

Correctness.Note: F1-F3 dispositions verified in the amended criteria (T-002 theme mapping, T-003 normalization, T-001 t()-based preset labels); budgets re-checked against recent whole-suite timings (vitest ≲ 400 s, two e2e specs ≲ 300 s on this host) — 900 s holds.

UX.Note: F4 disposition verified in T-003 (slots as focusable inputs with left→center→right tab order).

Correctness.Note: Re-read of the final draft: task graph acyclic (T-001 → T-002 → T-003 → T-004/T-005 → T-006), every ObservedWriteScope entry consumed by a task, every corner mapped to a task criterion (1,4,6,8 → T-002; 2,3 → T-003; 7 → T-004; 5 → T-005).
